dedupe_keys.name: swx trec space weather data portal

description: The SWx TREC Space Weather Data Portal displays and serves diverse space weather data from the Sun to the Earth side by side, organised and synchronised by time range so that users can explore space weather events. It is run by the Laboratory for Atmospheric and Space Physics and the Space Weather Technology, Research, and Education Center of the University of Colorado Boulder, and was released in 2019 for researchers, forecasters and students who would otherwise have to work with many storage interfaces. The portal aggregates data in real time directly from the definitive source with metadata; it does not create new products or keep a local copy. Coverage is global, with each dataset's own time span and resolution. Format and access: a web application with downloads, and an API for programmatic access; users can request new datasets through a form, and publications should cite its DOI. Licence: not stated on the page; the underlying data keep their providers' terms; free. Caveats: availability depends on the upstream archives. It supports hazard exposure studies of geomagnetic storms for grids and satellites. Related catalogue records are the NOAA SWPC products and the OMNIWeb solar wind data.
